tasks.title: Point dataclass
tasks.statement: Define a dataclass Point with fields x and y (numbers, default 0) and a method distance_to(other) that returns the distance to another point (math.hypot).
tasks.hint: @dataclass over class Point; x: float = 0; y: float = 0.

tasks.title: A playlist without a shared list
tasks.statement: Define a dataclass Playlist with fields name (a string) and songs (a list, empty by default, but separate for each instance) and a method add(song) that adds a song.

tasks.title: Immutable money
tasks.statement: Define an immutable (frozen) dataclass Money with fields amount (a number) and currency (a string), compared by the order of its fields (order=True).
tasks.hint: @dataclass(frozen=True, order=True) gives you freezing, sorting, and a hash at once.

tasks.title: Order status
tasks.statement: Define an enumeration Status with members NEW = 'new', PAID = 'paid', SHIPPED = 'shipped' and a method is_active() that returns True for NEW and PAID and False for SHIPPED.
tasks.hint: NEW = 'new' and so on; is_active: return self in (Status.NEW, Status.PAID).

tasks.title: Access permissions
tasks.statement: Define a Flag enumeration Perm with members R, W, X (using auto) and a function describe(p) that returns a three-character string, for example «rw-» for R|W and «r-x» for R|X.
tasks.hint: ('r' if Perm.R in p else '-') + ... for W and X.

tasks.title: A function with type hints
tasks.statement: Write a function average(nums, default) with type hints: nums is list[float], default is float (0.0 by default), and the result is float. It returns the mean, and for an empty list it returns default.
tasks.hint: def average(nums: list[float], default: float = 0.0) -> float:

tasks.title: Area with match
tasks.statement: Write a function area(shape), where shape is a list ['circle', r], ['rect', w, h], or ['square', a]. Return the area (for a circle use 3 * r * r, so as not to depend on pi). For any other shape, return None. Use match/case.
tasks.hint: case ["circle", r]: return 3 * r * r; case ["rect", w, h]: ...; case _: return None.

tasks.title: An independent copy
tasks.statement: Write a function clone_and_fill(matrix, value) that returns a copy of a list of lists in which ALL the numbers are replaced with value. The original table must not change. Use copy.deepcopy and a nested loop.
tasks.hint: result = copy.deepcopy(matrix); for row in result: for j in range(len(row)): row[j] = value.
